question: What are 'Bullets' in Microsoft Word?

options.text: Small dots, squares, dashes, or graphics preceding text

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Small dots, squares, dashes, or graphics preceding text**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bullets** are symbols used to introduce** items in a list.**
 
• They can be small dots, squares, dashes, or even custom graphics.
 
• Bullets help in breaking down information into easily digestible points.
 
• They are commonly used in documents to enhance readability and organization.
 
• Microsoft Word provides various bullet styles to choose from, allowing customization to fit the document's design.
 
• Using bullets can make complex information more accessible and highlight key points effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Characters used for decoration**__

 __
 
• Characters used for decoration in Microsoft Word are typically special symbols or fonts used to enhance the visual appeal of text.
 
• They are not used for listing items but rather for ornamental purposes.
 
 
 
• **Large circles indicating importance**__
 __
 
• Large circles can be used to indicate importance, but they are not the standard format for bullets in Microsoft Word.
 
• They are more often used in graphical representations or to emphasize specific points visually.
 
 
 
• **Highlighted text**__
 
 
• Highlighted text refers to text that has been marked with a different background color to stand out.
 
• This is different from using bullets, which are used to list items.
